name: qs1qgx-container-viewer
goal: Prove the viewer can navigate a focused popup, and an eligible Hub ask opens the MB2 viewer only through Cloudflare identity and device approval.

evidence: Stock popup lacks browser chrome. Viewer delegates navigation to focused Chromium tab. Hub opens a protected top-level viewer from the corresponding ask. The origin preserves device approval after Cloudflare authentication.

The preexisting gate checks pairing and VNC only. Its approved-device test now checks the navigation surface. Existing desktop and phone Needs You row tests now open the per-item viewer detail and follow the exact protected origin.
